conviction_note: Q1 (Jun-Aug 2026) of a company that sets conservative H1 plans and does not revise at Q1; the FX translation tailwind and a high progress rate against the H1 plan roughly offset a tough comparison (last year's Q1 carried a one-off settlement royalty and an FX gain), so the findings sum to +0.6 and the scaled number is a weak lean (p_up 55) on a 2.5% scale; no revision, no new return and no new-year guide is expected at this print.
bar: Last year's Q1 operating profit 4,462m yen (headline yoy basis kabutan will print), from the FY2026 Q1 決算短信 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251007/140120251002567694.pdf ; company H1 FY2027 plan OP 6,000m / ordinary 5,500m and FY plan OP 13,500m / ordinary 13,500m from https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=1377 (26/07/13); street FY ordinary consensus 14,545m (OP 13,895m) on https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=1377 (2026-10-05), effectively one broker (Nomura). No quarterly consensus exists, so the quarter bar is my own estimate and every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: no disclosed position >=0.5% (short_ratio 0.0, change 0.0, as of 2026-09-29, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 1.92 (kabutan 2026-10-06), not crowded either way. No options, no skew. Run-up -3.07% 20d / -0.70% 5d; stock ~6% off its 2026-08-21 high of 4,525. Nomura Buy maintained, TP 6,200->6,500 on 2026-09-10 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=1377&b=n202609101007). The company's own ¥5bn / 1.0m-share market buyback is running (118,900 shares bought in August). priced_lean_pct +0.011, essentially flat.

findings.finding: Overseas subsidiaries' Q1 P&L is translated at the end-June spot rate (company's stated method); end-June 2026 was USD/JPY 162.63, EUR/JPY 185.61, BRL/JPY 31.41 against last year's Q1 rates of 144.82 / 169.64 (BRL ~26.5) and against the FY27 plan's 155 / 180, a translation lift of roughly +9 to +19% on ~73% of sales (overseas wholesale was 16,774m of 23,005m last Q1) and roughly +3 to +5% above the plan rate.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last year's Q1 absorbed a -1,092m FX translation hit on sales and still beat (OP +63.5%); stock rose 10.2% on 2025-10-08, but that day also carried a tender-offer buyback. No clean history of the FX line alone.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the rates are public and Nomura's above-plan number likely already includes them. What is not in the price is the size of the yoy translation swing in a quarter whose headline yoy comparison is otherwise tough; if it were priced the stock would not have drifted -3% into the print with no disclosed seller.
findings.independence: FX closes from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/JPY=X?range=2y&interval=1d (and EURJPY=X, BRLJPY=X); the translation method and plan rates come from the same 短信. Macro-to-company transmission, hence the small size.

findings.finding: Last year's Q1 is a tough comparison: it carried a one-off royalty from a legal settlement in gross profit (overseas 'other' sales jumped 327m->771m, about +444m) plus a ~404m non-operating FX gain (ordinary 4,866m vs OP 4,462m), while the parent's FX book barely moved this quarter (USD/JPY 159.27 at May-end vs 159.75 at Aug-end, EUR flat), so headline yoy ordinary profit is likely to print down mid-to-high single digits even if the business grew.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance found of this name printing a yoy decline against a one-off-inflated comp; the Q3 print of 2026-04-07 (OP 2,428m vs 3,304m LY, -27%) was followed by a -7.0% move on 2026-04-08.
findings.why_not_priced: The one-off is in last year's documents, so an attentive holder knows it (LESSONS rule 1 applies); what is left is the headline: kabutan's auto-headline reads yoy ordinary profit, and retail reads the headline. If priced, the stock would have held up into the print; instead it has drifted lower.
findings.independence: Same documents as the FX finding for the FX-gain half (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251007/140120251002567694.pdf, the Q1 短信 narrative naming 和解成立に伴うロイヤリティー収入); parent FX from Yahoo JPY=X.

findings.finding: The H1 plan is set well below last year (H1 OP 6,000m, -13% yoy; ordinary 5,500m, -29%) in the same pattern as last year, when the H1 plan was OP 5,000m (-11.9%), Q1 alone reached 89% of it with no revision at Q1, and H1 actual came in at 6,895m (+38% above plan); a Q1 OP near 4.2-4.5bn would put progress at ~70-75% of the H1 OP plan and ~80% of the ordinary plan, which reads strongly against a plan rather than against last year.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-07 Q1 with 89% progress vs H1 plan: +10.2% next session (shared with a same-day tender-offer buyback, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251007/140120251003568195.pdf). 2026-07-13 FY print with dividend raise and new buyback: +1.3% (07-14 close 4,440 vs 4,385).
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus already sits above the FY plan (ordinary 14,545m vs 13,500m), so the conservatism is known to the one covering broker; what is not priced is the progress-rate headline that retail-heavy flow trades on. Sakata has not revised at Q1 in the record on irbank (2017-2025), so the upside resolves mainly at the Q2 print, outside this window.
findings.independence: H1 guide and quarterly history from https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=1377 ; revision record from https://irbank.net/1377/ir (no Q1 revisions listed). The Q1 estimate rests on the FX finding, so the two are not independent.

findings.finding: The company's own ¥5bn / 1.0m-share (2.36%) market buyback, resolved 2026-07-13 and running Aug 2026 to May 2027, bought 118,900 shares (¥522m) in August, a steady bid of roughly 5% of daily volume through the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Announced with FY results 2026-07-13; stock +1.3% the next session together with a dividend raise.
findings.why_not_priced: Known and mostly priced; what it does is cushion a negative headline reaction, since the buyer is in the market every day of the window.
findings.independence: Programme terms in https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260709590483.pdf ; same issuer, same programme.

findings.finding: Peer Kaneko Seeds (1376), which reports the same Jun-Aug quarter, posted Q1 ordinary profit +12.3% on 2026-10-05, with its seed segment up 2.4% on domestic sales and cabbage-seed exports, a mild read-through for Sakata's domestic wholesale (~19% of sales).
findings.why_not_priced: Out one day; small and domestic-only, so it is a proxy for under a fifth of Sakata's business, net of the 80% overseas that it says nothing about.

outside_window.finding: Upward revision of the conservative H1/FY plan (H1 OP 6,000m, FY ordinary 13,500m vs street 14,545m); Sakata's record revises at the Q2 print (2026-01-13, 2025-01-14, 2022-01-13 差異及び修正 notices), not at Q1.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: not expected (no Q1 revision on record; revisions come at Q2), and the street is already above plan. Returns: ¥5bn buyback already running, so nothing new expected (last year's Q1 tender offer was triggered by a founder-family sale). New-year guide: none (Q1). Quarter vs its own 進捗率: likely ~70-75% of the H1 OP plan vs 89% last year and ~48-55% in earlier years (of H1 actual), a high progress rate against a conservative plan, with the yoy headline flat to down on a one-off-inflated comparison.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Nomura Buy maintained, TP raised to 6,500 on 2026-09-10
rejected_candidates.detail: The same broker view is the consensus in the bar (kabuyoho 14,545m ordinary); recorded in bar and positioning_check rather than as a second finding.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Cyber-incident final report: personal data of ~44,000 customers possibly leaked; investigation complete
rejected_candidates.detail: The final report names no financial charge, and the FY27 guide of 2026-07-13 was set after the incident; nothing in a document puts a cost into Q1.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is flat (+0.011) with no disclosed shorts and a mild -3% run-down; my findings lean slightly positive, against that drift. The strongest positive this release could carry (a held conservative plan with high progress, plus a running buyback) is what I sized; the strongest negative is a yoy-decline headline on a one-off-inflated comparison. They mostly offset, so the scaled number stays well inside the proxy.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: the only negative (tough yoy comparison) was already sized as a computable-from-public-documents item at -0.4 with p_up held at 55 (rule 1); negatives do not outnumber positives and the strongest positives were looked for and filed (rule 2).
